privacy_policy: Teaching-only conditions, expected ordered tokens, IDs and opaque ordered-JSON snapshots. No raw SQL rows, timestamps, runtime identity, secrets, progress or private diagnostics.

review_summary.policy: Reuse fifteen sound and distinct existing thematic cases; no new question or link writes. Bounded Ukrainian criteria distinguish grammatical alternatives from the exact target.
checks: All 36 have complete ordered answer instances, linked type4 A2/B1/B1 models and thematic bank identities captured before M66 registration.
Hints and verb_hints are empty for all 36; variants contain the original Ukrainian condition. No new hint rows are needed.
All selected 15 are existing distinct own-topic cases. No real shortage, new questions/options/answers or direct practice links are assumed necessary.
Selected repeated the in Bare40110 remains two ordered instances though shared options are unique.
Bare40117 inherited noninitial Let is excluded: native ComposeTokenCase does not lower that word. Selected initial words and pronouns use existing native casing unchanged.
Fixed widget keys are target-specific, not a universal grammar judge; help-to and started-ing alternatives are acknowledged in visible criterion.
Remaining page-wide links outside the exact selected pool must remain untouched; main must verify matcher decoration pipeline and exact all-or-nothing snapshots.

clone_only_policy.notes: Prepend bounded Ukrainian criterion and retain source Ukrainian condition. Do not add unseen JS fields, mutate originals, copy M65 snapshots or add a token formatter. Unknown/partial matcher decorations must fail closed under root integration.
